name: Jennifer Langdon
bio: Jen Langdon began her career as a public middle school science teacher. After quickly reaching her goals—becoming a department lead and writing curriculum—she found herself asking, "What's the next challenge?" Inspired by the complexity of cybersecurity, she earned an associate degree and transitioned into the field. She soon discovered a strong demand for educators who could teach cyber concepts. This led her to a variety of roles, from building a cybersecurity computer game to creating a student-focused cyber podcast and producing content for companies in the industry. Now, she's come full circle. As a cybersecurity engineer at Cyber Skyline, she develops tools that help teachers bring hands-on tech education into their classrooms. Outside of work, she trains for and runs marathons across different states.
